goal_text: Find the data race in this JavaScript counter module. Identify the shared mutable state, explain the interleaving that loses increments, propose a fix using Atomics or a mutex pattern, and note one test that would flake without the fix.
ground_truth: Shared mutable count; concurrent += not atomic; lost updates; fix with Atomics or serialize increments; flaky test: incrementMany(1000) !== 1000
